channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Associação dos delegados rebate fala de Lula sobre chamar agentes que estão 'fingindo trabalhar'
item.description: The National Association of Federal Police Delegates (ADPF) criticized President Lula's remark calling federal police agents and delegates 'pretending to work,' stating that such statements disqualify officers and distract from structural issues in fighting organized crime. The ADPF emphasized the need for proper valuation, talent retention, and funding for the PF, and reiterated the importance of ongoing dialogue with the federal government to improve public security policies.

item.title: Zanin mantém presidente do TJ como governador do Rio
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled to keep Ricardo Couto, president of the Rio de Janeiro Court of Justice (TJ-RJ), in the role of state governor until the conclusion of the trial defining the model for the interim mandate election. The decision aims to ensure institutional stability while the method for filling the vacancy is debated.

item.title: A reação do STF para conter crise dos Poderes esbarra em um escândalo que não quer calar
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) is pursuing a political pact with Congress and the Presidency to ease an institutional crisis, led by Minister Gilmar Mendes in talks with the heads of the Chamber, Senate, and President Lula. The goal is to distribute responsibility and avoid perceptions that the crisis is solely the Court’s fault, rejecting an internal code of conduct as too politically costly. While Hugo Motta has signaled openness, skepticism remains due to electoral timing and uncertainty around Senate President Davi Alcolumbre’s stance.

item.title: Conheça Rodrigo Saccone, novo assessor da pré campanha de Flávio
item.description: Rodrigo Saccone, a journalist with experience in media and government, has been appointed press advisor for Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential pre-campaign. He leaves his roles at Holding In.Pacto and STA Comunicação to lead campaign communications, pledging transparency and dialogue with the press. His background includes ministerial roles and political TV coverage, which he says prepares him for this new challenge.

item.title: A aposta de Haddad para começar a minar favoritismo de Tarcísio
item.description: Former minister Fernando Haddad, the PT’s pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, has outlined a strategy to weaken Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’s frontrunner status, focusing on public security and controversies surrounding police conduct. Although Tarcísio leads in polls, Haddad’s performance has energized the PT, which sees him as a competitive ticket to support Lula’s 2026 re-election bid.

item.title: Flávio e Tarcísio participarão da Agrishow no interior de SP
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will make his first public appearance in the 2026 presidential pre-campaign alongside São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) at Agrishow 2026 in Ribeirão Preto on Monday, April 27. The event is strategically important for strengthening the right-wing alliance in the agribusiness sector, a key electoral battleground, and symbolizes a public unity between figures aligned with former President Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio’s appearance with Brazil’s most populous and wealthiest state governor reinforces his candidacy with substantial institutional backing.

item.title: Agente dos EUA deixa o Brasil após reação do governo Lula a medida de Trump
item.description: U.S. agent Michael Myers left Brazil after the Lula government applied the principle of reciprocity in response to the Trump administration's request for the withdrawal of a Brazilian Federal Police delegate operating in the U.S. Myers had been working since 2024 in intelligence cooperation between the PF and U.S. immigration authorities. His departure occurred before a formal order, following credential suspension, as a preventive measure while Brazil defined its official response.

item.title: Zanin decide que desembargador deve continuar como governador interino do Rio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Ricardo Couto, president of the Rio de Janeiro Court of Justice, must continue as interim governor until the STF plenary decides whether the succession will be indirect or direct. The PL had advocated for Douglas Ruas, president of the State Legislative Assembly, to assume office, while the PSD supported Couto’s continuation. The trial was suspended due to a view request by Flávio Dino and has no rescheduled date.

item.title: Gilmar, o camisa 10 da campanha de Zema
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Gilmar Mendes was described by allies of former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema’s pre-campaign as the 'number 10' of Zema’s presidential bid, signaling his strategic influence. Zema’s team reports growing social media presence and believes endorsements from figures like Mendes strengthen his electoral viability.

item.title: TSE publica acórdão que estabelece renúncia de Cláudio Castro
item.description: The TSE published the ruling confirming that Cláudio Castro’s resignation as governor of Rio de Janeiro was voluntary, not due to cassation, thus ruling out direct elections for the temporary mandate. The TSE panel voted 4–1 in favor of indirect election, with only Minister Cristiano Zanin advocating for direct elections. The final decision rests with the STF, which is currently on hold due to a view request by Minister Flávio Dino.

item.title: Câncer basocelular, como o de Lula, é comum e tem alta taxa de cura
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was diagnosed with basal cell carcinoma on his scalp, the most common type of skin cancer, which has a high cure rate when detected and treated early. Experts note the tumor is linked to chronic UV radiation exposure, rarely metastasizes, and is unrelated to his prior laryngeal cancer history. Prevention includes sunscreen, hats, and protective clothing, particularly for those with baldness or thin hair.

item.title: Zanin decide que presidente do TJ deve ser mantido como governador do Rio mesmo após eleição de Ruas na Alerj
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that Ricardo Couto, president of the Rio de Janeiro Court of Justice, must remain as interim governor despite Douglas Ruas being elected president of the state legislature. The decision affirms that Couto's role stems from a prior collegial STF ruling on the state election format, not an individual request. The PSD had sought reaffirmation of the ruling, while the Alerj had previously asked for Ruas to assume governorship.

item.title: Zanin diz que decisão do plenário que manteve Couto no governo do RJ permanece válida
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin upheld his March preliminary injunction, maintaining Ricardo Couto, president of the TJ-RJ, as acting governor of Rio de Janeiro, stating the plenary’s decision remains valid and requires no new ruling. Zanin also clarified that Douglas Ruas’s (PL) election as president of the Alerj does not alter the state’s succession line, as the governorship remains with Couto due to the executive vacancy following Cláudio Castro’s resignation and Rodrigo Bacellar’s removal.

item.title: Caiado prepara mudança para São Paulo e já ativa bases na capital e em Brasília
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is preparing to move to São Paulo in the coming weeks to intensify his presidential campaign, establishing his electoral headquarters in the city while maintaining a base in Brasília. The strategy aims to strengthen his presence in the Southeast and South regions, engage with business and financial sectors, and improve logistical access to key states such as Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro and Paraná.

item.title: Ministros do STF analisam acórdão do TSE sobre condenação de Castro para definir retomada de julgamento de eleição no Rio
item.description: STF ministers are reviewing the TSE's ruling on the conviction of former Rio governor Cláudio Castro to determine whether to resume the trial on the format of the state election. The debate centers on whether Castro's resignation, made just before the verdict, was an attempt to evade cassation and trigger an indirect election via the state legislature, or whether the vacancy should be treated as non-electoral, allowing Alerj to choose the successor under a suspended law. A key issue is whether diploma cassation is mandatory following a conviction for abuse of power, given that the TSE failed to secure a majority for cassation despite three votes in favor.

item.title: Lula passa por cirurgia para remover lesão cutânea da cabeça
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent successful surgery on Friday (24) in São Paulo to remove a skin lesion from his scalp. The procedure took place less than six months before the 2026 presidential elections, drawing attention to his health and potential implications for his campaign.

item.title: BC barra no Brasil mercados preditivos como Kalshi e Polymarket em eleições, esportes e reality shows
item.description: Brazil's Central Bank has banned the offering and trading within the country of derivatives tied to non-financial events such as elections, sports, reality shows, and social or cultural topics, under a new CMN resolution approved in April 2026 and effective May 4. The rule aims to protect investors, ensure transparency, and prevent harmful speculation, while allowing derivatives linked to verifiable economic and financial indicators. The CVM will issue complementary rules and oversee enforcement, including for foreign-traded products offered domestically.

item.title: Governo proíbe apostas esportivas, políticas e não financeiras em mercado preditivo e freia setor no país
item.description: The Brazilian federal government announced regulation of prediction markets, classifying them as fixed-odds betting requiring a license from the Ministry of Finance. The measure bans non-financial event betting—including sports, politics, reality shows, and wars—via derivative contracts, with the CVM overseeing enforcement. The rule, already partially enacted via a CMN resolution, prohibits derivative trading tied to non-economic-financial events, closing a regulatory loophole.

item.title: Procedimentos realizados por Lula não atrapalharão campanha, diz médico
item.description: Cardiologist Roberto Kalil Filho stated that the surgical procedures undergone by President Lula will not interfere with his re-election campaign, as he is expected to resume normal activities within a few days, including a scheduled engagement on Monday.

item.title: É #FAKE que Lula rebateu Trump e disse que 'o povo brasileiro está disposto a dar a vida por ele em uma guerra'
item.description: It is false that President Lula rebuked Donald Trump by saying the Brazilian people are willing to give their lives for him in a war. The image used in the post is AI-generated with 95.5% probability of being fake, and no such statement exists in official government channels or Lula's social media.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio corteja as eleitoras
item.description: Women made up 53% of the electorate in the 2022 elections and voted predominantly for Lula (PT) over Jair Bolsonaro (PL), making the female vote a key strategic target for Senator and PL pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who aims to win over this demographic in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Margareth Menezes viaja para China para celebração de Ano Cultural
item.description: Culture Minister Margareth Menezes will travel to China from April 27 to May 3 to participate in the Brazil-China Cultural Year 2026. The mission includes meetings with Chinese officials, visits to cultural institutions such as the JZ Spring Festival in Shanghai and the Kuaishou platform, and performances by Brazilian artists including Ivan Lins and Adriana Calcanhotto. The goal is to strengthen cultural cooperation, the circulation of works, and the creative economy between Brazil and China.

item.title: PT vai divulgar manifesto em defesa de mutirão pela democracia para enfrentar bolsonarismo
item.description: The PT will release a manifesto at its 8th Congress advocating for a democratic 'mutirão' uniting citizens across parties, beliefs, generations, workers, and business leaders. The document emphasizes unifying themes such as national sovereignty, ending the 6x1 workweek, zero-fare public transport, and strengthening public education as state policy, postponing divisive topics until after the 2026 elections. The strategy aims to avoid exposing internal rifts and focus on defending democracy against Bolsonarism.

item.title: PSD vai ao STF para impedir que Douglas Ruas assuma o governo do Rio
item.description: The PSD has filed actions with the STF to block Douglas Ruas, president of the Alerj and PL candidate, from assuming the interim governorship of Rio following Cláudio Castro's resignation. The party argues the succession line should reflect the situation at the time of vacancy, without later parliamentary changes. The case is tied to the ongoing STF review of the 'stop-gap' mandate in Rio, with uncertainty over whether the gubernatorial election will be direct or indirect.

item.title: Lula passa por cirurgia e remove lesão de câncer de pele na cabeça
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) underwent a surgical procedure on Friday (24) to remove a lesion on his scalp diagnosed as basal cell carcinoma, a less aggressive and more common form of skin cancer. The surgery was successful with no indications of further complications. Lula is expected to resume his normal activities after recovery.

item.title: Leia a íntegra do boletim médico do presidente Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, 80, underwent two surgical procedures at Hospital Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo on Friday, April 24, 2026: removal of a scalp lesion and a right wrist infiltration for tenosynovitis treatment. No complications were reported, and he is expected to resume normal activities on Monday, April 27, with ongoing medical follow-up.

item.title: Funcionário dos EUA deixa o Brasil após governo adotar reciprocidade
item.description: A U.S. government official working in Brazil left the country after Brazil adopted reciprocity measures in response to the United States removing a Federal Police delegate involved in the arrest of former deputy Alexandre Ramagem. The decision was announced by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Federal Police Director General Andrei Rodrigues as a diplomatic response. The move reflects rising tensions in bilateral relations over police cooperation and functional immunity.

item.title: De Toni cobra Itamaraty e Casa Civil por custos de viagem de Lula à Europa
item.description: Federal deputy Carol De Toni (PL-SC) requested clarifications from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Civil House regarding the costs of President Lula's trip to Europe, also questioning the size of the delegation — described as the largest of the current government — and the criteria for its composition. The request aims to ensure transparency in public spending related to the president's international travel.

item.title: QG de Lula será em prédio no Setor Comercial Sul, em Brasília
item.description: The re-election campaign of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will be headquartered in the Toufic Building in Brasília’s Commercial South Sector, near the party’s national headquarters. The 2022 campaign headquarters will instead serve Fernando Haddad’s bid for governor of São Paulo. Lula is running for an eighth presidential term, with campaign coordination led by PT national president Edinho Silva, who is also running for federal deputy from São Paulo.

item.title: PSD rebate Alerj no STF e pede que Douglas Ruas não assuma o governo do Rio
item.description: The PSD filed a petition with the STF to block the Alerj's request for Douglas Ruas to assume the Rio de Janeiro state government on an interim basis, arguing the move is improper and attempts to circumvent a prior Court ruling keeping Justice Ricardo Couto in office until a new decision. The party states the vacancy arose from Castro's resignation, not his impeachment, and advocates for direct elections to fill the remainder of the term. Douglas Ruas (PL) is a pre-candidate for governor, while the PSD backs Eduardo Paes for the same race.

item.title: TSE esclarece dúvida sobre renúncia de Castro, mas sucessão segue nas mãos do Supremo
item.description: The TSE recognized Claudio Castro's resignation as prejudicial to the cassation of his mandate, nullifying the judgment on cassation but leaving the format of the succession (direct or indirect) to the STF. Minister Flávio Dino, who requested a view, must analyze the TSE's acórdão before voting, delaying the final decision in the Supreme Court.

item.title: Crusoé: “Não faz sentido PL não ter candidatura própria no DF”, diz Izalci
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF), leader of the opposition in the Chamber of Deputies, defended his pre-candidacy for governor of the Federal District in an interview with O Antagonista and Crusoé. He argued that, as the PL is Brazil’s largest party and has strong influence in Brasília, it makes no sense for the party not to field its own candidate in the DF in 2026.

item.title: Lula passa por cirurgia para retirada de carcinoma basocelular no couro cabeludo; entenda o quadro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent surgery to remove a basal cell carcinoma from his scalp at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital. The procedure was performed without complications, with discharge expected today and relative rest recommended for the coming days, without anticipated impact on next week’s schedule. The lesion, common and low-aggressiveness, was excised with biopsy pending, and is unrelated to his 2024 fall injury.

item.title: O acórdão do TSE sobre Cláudio Castro
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) published the ruling that declared former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) ineligible, recognizing his departure from office as a resignation, not a removal, which rendered the analysis of diploma and mandate loss moot. Meanwhile, Rio's government remains under the interim presidency of TJ-RJ judge Ricardo Couto, after the Legislative Assembly elected PL deputy Douglas Ruas as its new president — a move the Assembly's General Prosecutor is urging the Supreme Court to recognize as grounds for his immediate swearing-in as interim governor.

item.title: Lula se somete a dos intervenciones médicas programadas en un hospital de São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was admitted this morning to a private hospital in São Paulo to undergo two scheduled medical procedures: an injection to treat tendinitis in his right thumb and the removal of a keratinous growth on his scalp. Both procedures were completed without complications, according to the medical team, and he is expected to be discharged later today.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: Oposição quer incluir opção para trabalhador escolher entre CLT ou receber por hora
item.description: The opposition proposes including Mauricio Marcon's (PL-RS) PEC in the special committee analyzing the end of the 6x1 work schedule, allowing workers to choose between CLT or hourly pay. The goal is to turn the government's proposal into an opportunity for a gradual reduction of the workweek (from 44 to 40 hours between 2027 and 2030), with payroll tax relief for affected sectors. PL leaders call the PECs of Erika Hilton and Reginaldo Lopes 'electoral' and harmful, but see room for negotiation.

item.title: Pela tese de Gilmar Mendes, criticar Romeu Zema seria atacar Minas
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes criticized former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema after an AI-generated video linked Mendes and Justice Dias Toffoli to the Banco Master scandal, mocking Zema's accent and making homophobic insinuations for which he later apologized. Mendes argues the Supreme Court plays only a marginal role in the scandals and claims the backlash is revenge for the Court's role in Bolsonaro's government and conviction, attempting to spread blame beyond the judiciary.

item.title: Lula recebe alta após procedimento para tirar lesão de pele no couro cabeludo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was discharged from Sírio Libanês Hospital after undergoing removal of a basal cell carcinoma on his scalp and an injection in his wrist to treat tendinitis. The procedures were complication-free, and his medical team stated he will resume normal activities in the coming days, including his re-election campaign for the October 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Médico diz que Lula retirou lesão e deve repousar nos próximos dias
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent a surgical procedure on Friday morning in São Paulo to remove a basal cell lesion from his scalp, according to his doctor Ricardo Kalil. The surgery was successful with no complications, and Lula is expected to rest at home for the coming days, avoiding large events, but without affecting his schedule or the 2026 presidential campaign. He also received an infiltration in his right hand to treat tendinitis.

item.title: Aliados de Lula acionam PGR e pedem suspensão da venda de mineradora de terras raras
item.description: Allies of President Lula, deputies Talíria Petrone (PSOL-RJ) and Orlando Silva (PCdoB-SP) have filed a request with the Attorney General’s Office (PGR) to investigate the sale of the Serra Verde rare earths miner to an American company. They are seeking to suspend the deal, valued at $2.8 billion (R$14 billion), citing national sovereignty and strategic concerns over critical minerals. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Lesão no couro cabeludo de Lula era um câncer basocelular
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva had a 1-centimeter basal cell carcinoma successfully removed from his scalp at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo. Doctors confirmed minimal risk of metastasis and cleared him to resume normal activities by Monday (April 27), advising only to avoid large events and wear a hat during the approximately one-month healing period.

item.title: Defesa de Castro pode apresentar recursos ao TSE após publicação do acórdão sobre condenação; entenda os próximos passos
item.description: The defense of former Rio de Janeiro governor Claudio Castro (PL) may file clarification appeals (embargos de declaração) with the TSE following the publication of the ruling that declared him ineligible until 2030 for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. The appeal, which must be filed within three days, aims to clarify potential obscurities or omissions in the decision without altering the judgment's outcome. Castro intends to appeal and run for the Senate in 2026 despite his ineligibility.

item.title: Lula usará curativo e chapéu por 1 mês após cirurgia, diz Kalil
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) underwent two medical procedures on Friday, April 24, 2026, including the removal of a 1 cm basal cell carcinoma from his scalp and treatment for tendinitis in his right wrist. Following the surgery, cardiologist Roberto Kalil Filho advised the use of a bandage and hat for approximately one month to support wound healing. Despite the precaution, Lula was discharged and cleared to resume normal activities, with a recommendation to avoid large gatherings in the coming days, and remains in good spirits, according to his medical team.

item.title: TSE publica acórdão do julgamento de Cláudio Castro, que está inelegível e não foi cassado
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) published the ruling that makes Claudio Castro (PL) ineligible for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. The majority of ministers determined that his resignation as governor of Rio de Janeiro was voluntary, not a removal, upholding the eight-year ineligibility penalty.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula sem gás
item.description: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz, resulting from the U.S.-Iran conflict that began in late February, threatens to raise fuel prices in Brazil, adding pressure to President Lula’s (PT) re-election bid. This development further complicates an already challenging economic landscape for his campaign.

item.title: Michelle pressiona família Bolsonaro por apoio a mulheres em postos-chave nas eleições deste ano
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is pressuring the Bolsonaro family to support female candidacies in key positions for the 2026 elections, advocating for Celina Leão’s nomination for the Federal District governorship and Priscila Costa as vice on Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential ticket. She rejects a merely honorary role in the PL and demands her influence be respected in party decisions, while Flávio has dismissed her complaints, heightening family tensions.

item.title: Procedimentos foram feitos sem intercorrências e Lula recebe alta em SP
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was discharged from São Paulo's Sírio-Libanês hospital after undergoing two medical procedures: cauterization for scalp keratosis and an infiltration for right thumb tendinitis. Medical staff confirmed no complications and stated he will resume activities in two days, with only minor precautions such as avoiding large events and wearing a hat.

item.title: Crusoé: O que Moraes dizia sobre a sátira de personalidades públicas
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF had previously stated that satire targeting public figures is legitimate and protected by the Constitution, even when offensive. His remarks resurfaced amid controversy over the animated series 'Os Intocáveis', produced by Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema, which criticizes STF ministers, including Gilmar Mendes, who reportedly objected to the content. The original Antagonista post notes that Moraes views criticism and humor as essential instruments of democratic debate.

item.title: Zema nega uso do Estado para benefício próprio ao se comparar a Flávio e intensifica ataques ao STF
item.description: Romeu Zema denied using the state for personal benefit while comparing himself to Flávio Dino and intensified his criticisms of the Supreme Federal Court (STF). The governor of Minas Gerais attended a meeting convened by Hugo Motta with other governors to discuss the Legal Framework for Combating Organized Crime.

item.title: O pedido de desculpas de Gilmar Mendes após fala homofóbica sobre Zema
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes apologized for a homophobic remark made against pre-candidate Romeu Zema, in which he equated homosexuality with crime. He maintained his criticism of Zema but retracted the offensive statement after backlash. The incident unfolded amid a public feud between the two, sparked by an animated video from Zema depicting Mendes in corrupt acts.
